caption: Each line is split into a north-south latitude and an east-west departure; the last row gives the signed sums, which are not zero, so the closed traverse has a misclosure. Individual entries are rounded to whole metres (the DA bearing is 303°20′ in the worked example), while the worked example uses unrounded values.

spec.title: Traverse ABCD: length (m), bearing, latitude (m), departure (m)
